title: Send a gradient back through pad and shrink
hints: shrink_offsets is already right. Look at the right-hand width that pad_widths builds for each axis.
An axis of size d holds o elements before the window, then the s elements of the window, then the rest. How many are in the rest?
The right-hand width is d - o - s, not d - s. For offset 2, size 3 and an axis of 6 that is 1.
explain: A pad's partner is a shrink that starts where x landed, so its offsets are the left widths: every other number of the pad list. A shrink's partner is a pad that puts the window back where it was cut from. On each axis the window had o elements before it and d - o - s after it, and those are the two pad widths. The starter forgot to take the offset away on the right, so the padded gradient came out too long.
